notes: Etsy is an online marketplace; most staffing, rental, building and agency facets do not apply. Fee-based charging is from general knowledge plus the evidence on low fees.

business_service_specialization.value: Online marketplace for handmade, vintage and unique goods, connecting sellers and buyers

service_operating_model.value: Two-sided online marketplace platform with seller tools, search and support; earns fees from sellers

charging_unit.value: Per-listing fee and fees on seller transactions, plus optional seller services such as promoted listings

customer_contract_term.value: No fixed term; sellers open shops and list items on demand, buyers purchase per order

contracted_repeat_revenue.value: Repeat marketplace transaction and listing fees from a large seller and buyer community; not contracted subscription revenue

software_deployment_737_software_service.value: Cloud-hosted web and mobile marketplace platform operated by Etsy

software_functional_scope_737.value: E-commerce marketplace with search, seller shop management tools and buyer discovery

processing_transaction_platform_7374.value: Marketplace transaction platform enabling buyer-seller exchange, with payments handled for sellers
